title: 五百羅漢圖（1971.16）
holder: 克利夫兰美术馆（藏品号 1971.16）
medium: Handscroll; ink and color on paper
one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「1591–1626」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: Handscroll; ink and color on paper
吳彬 Wu Bin (Chinese, active c. 1591–1626)

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → ming；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: Bi dian zhu lin shi ju bao ji xu bian 秘殿珠林石渠寶笈續编. Taibei: Guo li gu gong bo wu yuan [National Palace Museum], 1971. (original text dated 1793)（ch. 4, p. 55(b)）
Chen, Rentao 陳仁濤 [J.D. Chen]. Gu gong yi yi shu hua mu jiao zhu 故宮已佚書畫目校注. Hong Kong: Dongnan shu ju, 1956.（p. 40(a)）
Cahill, James. The Restless Landscape: Chinese Painting of the Late Ming Period. Berkeley, CA: University Art Museum, 1971.（Reproduced: cat. no. 77）
The Cleveland Museum of Art. Handbook of the Cleveland Museum of Art/1978. Cleveland, OH: The Cleveland Museum of Art, 1978.（Reproduced: p. 351）

Ho, Wai-kam, Sherman E. Lee, Laurence Sickman, and Marc F. Wilson. Eight Dynasties of Chinese Painting: The Collections of the Nelson Gallery-Atkins Museum, Kansas City, and the Cleveland Museum of Art. Cleveland, OH: Cleveland Museum of Art, in cooperation with Indiana University Press, 1980.（Reproduced: p. 263, cat. no. 205）
**馆方记录另有 7 条著录未在此列出。**

dating.text: 馆方给出了年代，**但未在公开记录中说明这个年代依据什么**——是铭文、器形序列、共出器物还是风格比对，无从得知。本库的断代十档因此无法填写：**填任何一档都是替馆方作了它没作的声明。**

colophons.text:
枝隱頭陀吳彬齋心拜寫  [印]吳彬之印; 文中父

馆方英译：Artist's inscription, signature, and 50 seals:  

Zhiyin toutuo, Wu Bin, purified his heart and respectfully painted. [2 seals] Wu Bin zhi yin; Wen zhong fu.  

[48 seals on painting] Wen zhong fu (repeated 26 times); Wu Bin zhi yin (repeated 22 times).
以上为克利夫兰美术馆藏品记录里的题跋与钤印著录，**本库未核对原件**；款印的真伪、题跋者身份与年代均未独立判定。

provenance.text: Qing imperial collection (seals of Emperor Qianlong, r. 1736–1795)
Cheng Qi 程琦 [1911–1988] by descent to his son, Stephen O. K. Chen
Stephen O. K. Chen [20th century], New York, sold to the Cleveland Museum of Art
The Cleveland Museum of Art, Cleveland, OH
以上递藏链照录自馆方档案。**本库未独立核实其中任一环节**；经手人身份、交易性质与时间点均以馆方记录为准，本库不据此判定流散性质。
